title: Service Level Breaches and the Early Termination Fee
content:
Under the Paystride Earned Wage Access Program Agreement, repeated service level breaches lower the early termination fee: where at least 2 service level credits were booked on entry dates from which fewer than 6 whole months have passed to today, the fee is multiplied by 0.5; where exactly 1 was, by 0.8; otherwise it is not multiplied.

A whole month from an entry date is reached on the same day of the month as that entry date, or on the first day of the next month where that month has no such day.

| Service level credits booked in the window | Fee multiplied by |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | 0.5 |
| exactly 1 | 0.8 |
| none | not multiplied |

Hypothetical case: with one service level credit booked 4 months ago and another booked 7 months ago, only the first is in the window and the fee is multiplied by 0.8.
